t: Stop Signs Suck and We Should Get Rid of Them

q.x: Four way stops are one of the dumbest inventions of man kind that are way over used in North America. Everyone has to stop all the time and it leads to scary situations at 2 way stops because people don't expect those anymore.

cites.stt: The Colorado Safety Stop is the law of the land
cites.x: If you don't have to stop at an intersection, you get through the intersection much faster and are therefore in less danger.
